release_notes: Modular LLM Agent Harness Architecture: Re-architected harness runtime into a modular stage taxonomy (history, prompt, budget, compaction, streaming) with unified execute_turn orchestration and decoupled NLP clause chunking.

Harness Production Hardening & Async Resilience: Sealed stage encapsulation, offloaded blocking Turso DB and compaction inference off the Tokio reactor, automated user turn rollback on stream error, and zero-overhead prompt synchronization.

Universal Compaction Contract & Cognitive Ladder: Shipped strict 6-bucket JsonSchema SSOT with reasoning disabled across Ollama and remote transports, 400-negotiation downgrade, and verified 2-stage memory deduplication (Jaccard + MiniLM ONNX cosine).

Core Pipeline 4-Pillar Standardization: Standardized TTS, STT, VAD, and LLM services around dedicated OS-thread actors, declarative contracts, and domain-isolated provider factories with zero compiler warnings.

Text-as-Input & Ephemeral Voice Sessions: Introduced direct keyboard text input with auto-resume from Paused and Sleeping states, mic and speaker mute controls, and zero-persistence Temporary Chat sessions.

Streaming Audio Prosody & Speech Normalization: Integrated pre-synthesis text normalization for numbers, currencies, and units, refined clause boundary prosody for Kokoro TTS, and verified 11-speaker profile mapping.

linux.update_command: sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade vox
